name: Aphrodite
summary: Goddess of love, beauty, and desire. Her judgment-winning gift to Paris, the love of Helen, is the mythic spark that ignites the Trojan War.
origin_story: Two origin stories exist. In Hesiod's account, Aphrodite arose from the sea foam formed when the Titan Cronus cast the severed genitals of his father Uranus into the ocean, making her older than the Olympians themselves. Homer's account instead makes her a daughter of Zeus and the minor goddess Dione, born as an ordinary Olympian.
achievements: Awarded the golden apple in the Judgment of Paris by promising him the world's most beautiful woman, Helen, setting the Trojan War in motion
Supported Troy during the Trojan War
Widely worshipped across the Greek world, with major cult centers on Cyprus and Cythera

signature_quote.text: The Judgment of Paris is consistently framed in Greek tradition as the mythic origin point of the Trojan War, with Aphrodite's promise to Paris at its center.
